issue.title: sessions: 把 Codex 会话换到另一个 provider 会挪动 Codex 记下的字节偏移，Codex 开着这个会话时还会丢掉它之后写的内容
issue.body:
和 #3616 是同一类问题，出在把 Codex 会话换到另一个 provider 上。两个入口最后都走 `moveCodexPaths` → `rewriteCodexProvider` → `setMetaProvider`：一个是 Sessions 里手动移（`MoveCodexProvider`，#887）；另一个不用点，Codex 离开 magpie 时（Disconnect、手改配置、magpie 退到 ChatGPT 登录旁边），magpie 会把在 magpie 上开的线程移到 Codex 当前的 provider（`bringBack` → `MoveCodexThreads`）。

一是长度。`setMetaProvider` 原地换掉 session_meta 里的 `model_provider`，新旧 id 长度不同时，第一行之后每一行的起点都跟着挪。Codex 是按自己记下的字节偏移读 rollout 的：fork 和回滚（`thread/revert`）的 `history_base`，还有 thread_history_1.sqlite 里每个 turn 的起止和 projection 接着读的位置。

用真的 Codex CLI 0.164.0 跑的（main afc99490，本地假 upstream），一个线程加它末尾的 fork，用 `MoveCodexThreads` 一起移（bringBack 就是这么移的）：

- `fake-provider` → `fake`，短 9 字节：11 个偏移里 6 个落在行中间，5 个超过文件末尾。fork 再 resume 直接失败，base 能 resume：
  ```
  invalid paginated history lineage for <fork id>: cutoff byte offset is past the source rollout (code -32600)
  ```
- `fake` → `fake-provider`，长 9 字节：11 个偏移全落在行中间。fork 和 base 都能 resume，偏移还是错的。

bringBack 是从 `magpie` 移走，移到默认的 `openai`（也是 6 个字符）碰不到；新旧 provider id 长度不同才会碰到，移过去、移回来都一样。变短的可以像 #3616 的补丁那样在行尾补空格。变长的补不了，除非只改 state 数据库里那一行、不动 rollout；Codex 列线程看的是哪一个、之后会不会照 rollout 改回去，我没试。

二是锁。`rewriteCodexProvider` 不拿 Codex 的 writer lock，只看一分钟内有没有写过。可 Codex resume 一个线程时就把它的 rollout 以追加方式打开，一直拿着（`open_rollout_for_append`），之后写的行都进这个句柄。试了一下：一个 `codex app-server` resume 线程后闲着，70 秒后 `MoveCodexThreads` 把它移走，再在同一个 app-server 里跑一轮。这一轮上游收到了，也答完了（`turn/completed`），可磁盘上的 rollout 里没有它；之后 Codex 再 resume 这个线程，发出去的历史里也没有这一轮。新写的行进了被换掉的那个旧文件。#3616 的 port 是照 Codex 发布压缩 rollout 的方式写的：拿着 `thread-writer-locks/.coordination.lock`，线程的锁空着才写，有 Codex 开着就留到下一轮（`codex_portable.go`）。换 provider 大概也该这样。

#3616 的补丁没动这里。

comments.body:
已在我的 fork 分支 `fix/3751-codex-meta-length` 修好（head `7e061eda`，基于 upstream `6afbe3f3`）：改写 provider 不再移动 Codex 记下的字节偏移。

**根因**：`internal/sessions/codex_provider.go` 的 `setMetaProvider` 用 `line[:r.Index] + json(to) + line[r.Index+len(r.Raw):]` 重建 session_meta 行：provider id 变短或变长，行长就变，它后面的每一处偏移都错位，Codex 开着这个会话时接着写就会覆盖或错位。

**改动**：改写后的行长度保持不变——新 id 更短时用 JSON 值后的空格补齐（合法 JSON），更长时拒绝改写并返回"没写"，交给既有的"一个 Codex 开着它"那条路处理，而不是移动偏移。写入锁那半边是 #3616 的模式，未纳入本次范围。

**验证**：红 —— `go test -tags nogui ./internal/sessions/ -run TestSetMetaProviderKeepsByteOffsets` → `shorter_by_9: codex_meta_length_test.go:61: the file is 310 bytes, was 319`；`longer_by_9: :48: written true, want false`；绿 —— `三个子例全绿：逐行等长、第二行起始偏移不变、补齐后的行仍是合法 JSON、更长的 id 一个字都不写；既有的 `TestMoveCodexProvider*` 不受影响` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/sessions`。

只修长度这一半；Codex 正在写时的并发（#3616 的 writer lock）仍按原样留给那边的方案。

补充：本轮所有分支合起来的 `go test -tags nogui ./...` 是 70 个包 ok、5 个包红（edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`、gateway 五个、plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`、provider `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials` 的 synctest fatal、testenv `TestProgram`），这五个在基线 `6afbe3f3`、本机 umask 0027 下逐字同样红，不是这次改动带来的。

分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3751-codex-meta-length。没有开 PR（本仓库不收外部 PR）；如果更希望直接把 patch 贴在这里，说一声即可。

67b12956 把长度那一半修了：rewriteCodexProvider 现在也用 fitLine 补空格，paginated 的 rollout 碰到更长的 provider id 就不改。锁那一半还在，74dcf40a 上 rewriteCodexProvider 还是不拿 Codex 的 writer lock。这一半我来改：照 port 的 editRollout 那样拿锁，线程被 Codex 开着就先不移。

Patch: https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/tree/fix/3751-move-lock, commit 8a5f605e on origin/main 74dcf40a (applies as is on 1a804859), `git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout 74dcf40a..8a5f605e | sha256sum` is `050eeb053d7e973154ce72289fa17e8799b20a3c78b418eda1cf38f6ab53eb8c`.

锁这一半：移动现在像 Codex 自己归档线程那样，从文件拷进回收站之前一直到 state 数据库那一行改完，都拿着这个线程的 writer lock；线程被 Codex 开着就整个不动，Sessions 页给的还是「仍在写入；请在 Codex 中关闭它，一分钟后再试」那条提示，bringBack 等下次同步再移。没直接用 editRollout，是因为它一次只发布一个文件，而一个线程的几个文件和那一行得一起移，它也没法像 67b12956 那样拒绝更长的 id。用真的 Codex 0.164.0 跑了：74dcf40a 上 app-server 开着线程时移走，之后那一轮在 rollout 里就没了；打补丁后这次移动跳过它，那一轮留着，app-server 退出后再移就过去了。没在 Windows、macOS 和 Codex 桌面 app 上试过；另外 0.164 的 app-server 闲着的线程要 30 分钟后才放锁，所以「一分钟后再试」在桌面 app 里可能要等半小时，另开了 #3986。

coffemon's patch landed as bec9df088 (author kept) and ships in v0.1.2381. A provider move now takes Codex's writer lock, the same way Codex's own writer_lock.rs does, so a thread a Codex has open is left where it is and shows as in use. The review checked: on main the three new tests are red, with the change they pass, and four hand-breaks each turn one red. It ran internal/sessions and internal/agent on macOS, the move tests on Windows and Linux, plus -race and vet for every OS. Not tried: a real Codex CLI or app holding a thread during a move, or a WSL distro's Codex moved from Windows.
在 v0.1.2381 上验过：TestMoveCodexProviderLeavesAnOpenThread、TestMoveCodexProviderHoldsTheThread 和 TestMoveCodexThreadsLeavesAnOpenThread 各跑 5 次都绿，把 codex_provider.go 和 codex.go 换回合并前的版本，三个都红。谢谢合进去，关了。

issue.title: sessions: the Move's "try again in a minute" for a thread the Codex app has open can be half an hour

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Since #3751's patch, the Sessions page's Move leaves a Codex thread
that a Codex has open (its `thread-writer-locks/<thread>.lock` held)
and says, as it does for one written to in the last minute: "{title} is
still being written to; close it in Codex and try again in a minute"
(`moveProviders` in `internal/gui/assets/plugins/sessions/client.js`;
the reply's refusal is `active`, since the error is `ErrActive` too).

`codex exec` lets the thread go as it exits (the interactive TUI wasn't
tried). Codex 0.164.0's app-server, which the Codex app drives, keeps a
thread loaded, and its lock held, until 30 minutes after it went idle
with nothing subscribed to it (`thread_unload_delay_secs`,
`unwrap_or(/*default*/ 1800)` in codex-rs/core/src/config/mod.rs at
rust-v0.164.0, 60 in 0.154; the rule is `UnloadingState` in app-server's
thread_lifecycle.rs), or until the app-server ends. So a user who closes
the thread in the app and tries again a minute later is refused again,
with the same words, for up to half an hour, unless they quit the app.

What would fix it: the refusal says the thread is open in a Codex (an
`open` beside `active`, from the error, which `sessions` would export),
and the page says that and what lets it go: "{title} is open in Codex;
quit Codex and try again, or try again in half an hour" and its plural,
in en, zh, zh-TW, ja and de (`plugins/sessions/i18n.js`), with
sessions-codex-provider.test.cjs given an open refusal. app.js isn't
touched.

Read from the code and from Codex's source. The half hour was not timed
against the Codex app; the lock held while an app-server has the thread
open, and the Move refused then, were tried with Codex CLI 0.164.0's
app-server (#3751's patch body).

issue.title: gui tests: session-identity red in WebKit on Linux (WSL): the wheel never scrolls the third ledger row up (main bb5e68cea)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
\`internal/gui/tests/session-identity.test.cjs\`, \`webkit: session account identities\`, is red on Linux (WSL magpie-desktop, Playwright 1.62.0 WebKit) at origin/main bb5e68cea, 3 runs of 3 with \`BROWSER=webkit\` and the file run alone. Chromium passes.

Two subtests fail, \`en / light\` and \`zh / dark\`:

\`\`\`
error: 'page.waitForFunction: Timeout 30000ms exceeded.'
stack: TestContext.<anonymous> (internal/gui/tests/session-identity.test.cjs:119:20)
\`\`\`

Line 119 waits after \`page.mouse.wheel(0, rowTop - 400)\` for the third \`.led-row\` to move up by more than 100px. In WebKit on Linux the row doesn't move. Either the wheel doesn't reach the ledger's scroller at (700, 400), or the page has nothing to scroll at that size.

The same tree with the #3492 and #3751 patches on top gives the same result, 3 of 3. coffemon's #3492 body also lists this file as red on f8cd964a. Seen while reviewing those patches. Nobody has taken it.

issue.title: Codex portable rollout rewrite invalidates persisted byte offsets, breaking paginated history resume

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### Summary

`PortCodexRollouts` rewrites rollout lines that contain magpie's `magpie1:` compaction item. It preserves the rollout's line count and mtime, but not its byte length: a line re-encoded by `portLine` is usually shorter than the original. Codex stores absolute byte offsets for paginated history in two places:

- `thread_history_1.sqlite`: `thread_history_projection_state.next_rollout_byte_offset` and `thread_turns.rollout_byte_offset` / `rollout_end_byte_offset`
- continuation rollouts: `session_meta.payload.history_base.end_byte_offset`

After a port pass those offsets point past EOF or to the wrong line, and Codex refuses to resume the thread:

```
invalid paginated history lineage for <thread>: cutoff byte offset is past the source rollout
```

### Environment

- magpie 0.1.1545 (GUI, macOS)
- Codex Desktop 0.164.0-alpha.11.1
- macOS 25.5.0
- model routed through magpie; `nativeCompaction` left off, so magpie answers Codex's compaction trigger itself with a `magpie1:` item

### Observed

A base rollout of 90,185,952 bytes / 25,442 lines had 39 lines rewritten by `portLine` and shrank by 53,663 bytes. Codex's projection state still pointed at 90,239,615 (53,663 bytes past the new EOF), and a continuation rollout's `history_base` still had `end_byte_offset: 90,231,332` for ordinal 25,434. After the rewrite that ordinal starts at 90,177,669 — exactly 53,663 bytes earlier. Codex's `rollout_contains_prefix` only checks `end_byte_offset <= file_len`, so resume fails with the error above.

### Why it happens

Codex assumes rollouts are append-only. `PortCodexRollouts` publishes the rewritten file under the writer lock, so no Codex is writing during the rename, but Codex has already persisted offsets into the old byte layout. Preserving line count and mtime hides the change from checks that only look at those, while every absolute offset after the first shortened line is shifted.

### Suggested fix

Preferred: make `portLine` preserve the original line's byte length. JSON permits trailing whitespace, so when the replacement is shorter, pad it with spaces before the line ending:

```go
if len(out) < len(line) {
    body := bytes.TrimRight(out, "\r\n")
    end := out[len(body):]
    out = append(body, bytes.Repeat([]byte(" "), len(line)-len(out))...)
    out = append(out, end...)
}
```

Then the file size and all subsequent offsets stay valid, and the change really is transparent to Codex. A test could assert `len(out) == len(line)` for every rewritten line.

If the replacement can be longer than the original, that line can't be padded to the original length; options are to skip porting that rollout, or to update Codex's persisted offsets in `thread_history_1.sqlite` and every descendant rollout's `history_base.end_byte_offset` (much more invasive and version-dependent).

At minimum, detect that a rollout belongs to a paginated history and skip porting it rather than leaving it unopenable.

Related upstream reports: openai/codex#52412 and openai/codex#52551 (same error; Codex expects append-only rollouts).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Use Codex Desktop through magpie with a model whose compaction magpie answers itself (`nativeCompaction` off).
2. Let Codex trigger compaction; the rollout gets a `compaction` item with `encrypted_content: "magpie1:..."`.
3. Wait for `PortCodexRollouts` (2 minutes after start / every 10 minutes) to rewrite the rollout.
4. Reopen the thread in Codex. Resume fails with `invalid paginated history lineage ... cutoff byte offset is past the source rollout`.

### Code references

- `internal/sessions/codex_portable.go`: `portRollout` (line 209), `portLine` (line 323)
- `internal/codexsummary/codexsummary.go`: `Mark` (line 23), `Encrypted` (line 31), `Message` (line 39)
- `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md` line 177 describes the current behavior
